liebermann.description_de: Gemeinsame Vorlage für H und B
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of H and B, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: Af, Ine, Blas, Forf, EGu, II As, Swer, Wer, I Ew, II Ew, I Em, II Em, I Atr, Wif, Becwæð
liebermann.notes: A common source of H and B for Alfred–Ine, Blas and Forf, EGu, II As, Swer, Wer, I–II Ew, I–II Em, I Atr, Wif, the charm against cattle theft and Becwæð, posited by Liebermann, who calls it a collector (“Sammler hb”); in his view it had already introduced prepositions into Ine and probably contained the Wessex genealogy.

entries.text_de: Gemeinsame Vorlage für H und B in Af-Ine, Blas u. Forf, EGu, II As, Swer, Wer, I. II Ew, I. II Em, I Atr, Wif, Zauber gegen Viehdiebstahl, Becwæð.
entries.text_en: Common exemplar for H and B in Af-Ine, Blas u. Forf, EGu, II As, Swer, Wer, I. II Ew, I. II Em, I Atr, Wif, charm against cattle-theft, Becwæð.

transcription.doubts: 'u.' between Blas and Forf appears bold (part of the bold run). The crib keeps 'Blas u. Forf' unchanged as a code-name group.
